object.content:
Are you frustrated by having to scroll through very long posts appearing in your timeline on Mastodon?

You can avoid this happening by using either your server's website or web app, or using a third party app. These automatically hide very long posts behind a "Read more" link which you can click open. (For some reason only the official apps don't shorten long posts.)

More info on all the different ways of accessing Mastodon at https://fedi.tips/which-apps-can-i-use-should-i-use-the-official-app-or-a-third-party-app

#FediTips #Mastodon

object.content:
How Fediverse accounts work:

If you get a SIM card for your phone, it lets you access your phone provider's services. You can call people on other providers because the global phone network is federated.

If you get an account on a Fediverse server, it lets you access that server's services. You can follow and interact with people on other servers because the Fediverse is federated.

However, a SIM card only works with one phone provider and a Fediverse account only works with one server.
